notes: SR10: 'Identifier-3 and identifier-4 shall specify group data items and shall not be reference modified.' A CD record group is a group item, so MOVE CORR CG TO WG (CD sender), WH TO CK (CD receiver) and CG TO CK (both) are accepted and run (g2mov19 M1-M3). The prohibition is witnessed by g2mov20: identifier-3 CE1 OF CG, an elementary CD record item, is refused at line 21 while the group control at line 22 is accepted. Run at --std 2002 on the pinned dc1f2dcce8 build matched.
